admission.justification: Inferring the wrong owner can close another leaf history or turn unavailable public recovery into a false success claim.

applicability: Direct leaf ownership selection and the admitted recovery executor boundary.
conditions: An explicit valid leaf_id selects and closes that history, including rowless history.
Without leaf_id exactly one open owner is inferred.
exclusions: Public lifecycle-control recovery for an intent-less direct generation is refused; executor recovery is separately evidenced, not public-route success.
statement: direct_landing takes leaf_id (judges/closes the named leaf, refuses another leaf's open file, names leaf_id when none-or-several are open); the ruled substitute pair covers control recovery.
